% Existing calc, timeline CS and pre-picture macro fixtures, composed into
% one visual regression control. Their quotient tokens come from native PGF.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{calc}
\newcommand{\target}{4}
\newcommand{\anno}{1}
\pgfmathsetmacro{\myspacing}{2/(\target-\anno)}
\tikzdeclarecoordinatesystem{timeline}{%
  \pgfmathsetmacro\myx{(#1-1975)/3}
  \pgfpointxy{\myx}{0}
}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[blue] (-.5,-1) rectangle (5.5,3.5);
  \draw (timeline cs:1975) -- (timeline cs:1990);
  \foreach \year in {1975,1980,1985,1990} {
    \draw (timeline cs:\year) -- ++(0,.15) node[above] {\year};
  }
  \begin{scope}[yshift=1cm,x=\myspacing cm]
    \foreach \tick in {0,1,2,3,4} {
      \draw[green!50!black] (\tick,0) -- (\tick,1);
    }
  \end{scope}
  \def\thetas{5}
  \def\thetav{0.4}
  \fill[red] ($(0,2.5)+1/(1+exp(\thetas*\thetav))*(0,1)$) circle (2pt);
  \node[anchor=west] at (.3,2.6) {$1/(1+\exp(2))$};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
